title: Imp Jar Fizz Blackcurrant & Lemonade 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Blackcurrant & Lemonade from the Imp Jar Fizz collection captures the spirited essence of your favourite fizzy drinks, translated into a vibrant vape experience. The e-liquid weaves the rich, full-bodied flavour of blackcurrant with the crisp, refreshing zest of lemonade. It's a vape that tickles your taste buds with a hint of sparkle, reminiscent of a gently bubbling soda, offering a delightfully uplifting and satisfying experience with every puff. This delicious flavour is just one of several in Imp Jar’s Fizz series, a collection of vape juices which sparkle with all the fun and flavour of your favourite classic soda drinks. They feature a double-concentrate of extra flavour providing an intensely tasty experience akin to a disposable vape. Shortfill bottles from Imp Jar E-liquids offer a more versatile ratio of 50PG/50PG than traditional High-VG shortfills, which means you can use the e-liquid with a more diverse range of vape kits and coils of different resistances. With Imp Jar shortfills, you’re no longer limited to sub-ohm vaping kits, and can enjoy the superb value of shortfills in a huge variety of MTL vape kits. Each bottle comes with 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 10ml of space for one 10ml nicotine shot, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 1 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills offer even more longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours and are a more economical and convenient option over 10ml bottles of pre-mixed e-liquid. Imp Jar’s original collection of e-liquids replicate a wide array of delicious flavours made popular across numerous disposable vape devices, ranging from fruity delights to frosty menthols, sugary candies, to refreshing beverages.
